name: translation-sync
description: When a product's copy changes, translates the changed fields into every language you sell in and marks them for review, so no language falls behind.

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Translates only the source-language fields that changed, into each of your languages

howItWorks.label: Marks
howItWorks.text: Each new translation as needing review

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve the translations before they are saved

data.description: The product's name in the source language
The source-language fields to keep translated: name, description, bullet points, SEO title and description
Where translations live: fields per language, a translation entity, or localized fields
A per-translation field that marks a translation as needing review

parameters.label: Source language
parameters.description: The language the team writes product copy in

parameters.label: Translate into
parameters.description: Every language the store sells in, separated by commas

parameters.label: Fields to translate
parameters.default: name, description, bullet points, SEO title, SEO description
parameters.description: The source fields kept in sync

parameters.label: Needs-review value
parameters.description: What the review field is set to on each new translation
